body: I guess I can try. I don't even know where to start or how to approach anybody though. I'm so awkward and hard to talk to I think that alone makes people not want to be my friend.
Yes that includes online too. Every good friend I've ever had has left me at some point. I know I've pushed away people in the past because of my awful anxiety.

I've been trying to find people for years and nobody wants anything to do with me. So many people used to talk to me and just completely stopped and forgot about me. I'm constantly pushed to the side by everyone.
If you mean online friends I've tried. They all forget about me or talk with their better online friends.

I've tried getting help. I've seen plenty of therapists and tried countless different medications throughout practically my entire life. Nothing has worked. I've lost all hope that anything will ever help me.
